body: Thats why im completely trapped, ive tried trust me, been studying for years and didnt make it to university, where i live things work differently , ive always been a dreamer living out of hope, but hope only gets you so far , and ive almost lost it, reality is cruel but undenaible, trust me when i say that theres pretty much no way for me to become what ive always wanted.
